requestedOutcome: Refresh a checkpointed review branch after main advances without force-push, history rewrite, remote mutation, or repeated ad hoc Git reasoning.
routeChosen: Compose the existing checkpoint verifier and Git runtime through a bounded base-refresh adapter.
authorityBoundary: The adapter may create one local feature-branch merge commit after exact confirmation. It has no push, PR-write, main-write, promotion, roots, or CANON authority.
remainingGate: Every applied refresh requires new focused/full verification, a new checkpoint, independent review, and bounded publication.
